bounties.excerpt: ## Summary The bridge listener builds the node's off-chain shielded pool by decoding deposit instructions from chain history. Its decoder recognises only the legacy `deposit` and `deposit_spl` discriminators. The pinned program no longer has those instructions: its only deposit instruction is `deposit_note`, whose discriminator is defined in the codebase but never matched by the decoder. The listener therefore indexes nothing — for every deposit that can actually occur on this program version — and the pool it feeds stays empty while real deposits accumulate on-chain.
